name: CheMM-Bench
description:
CheMM-Bench Dataset
	

This directory contains the CheMM-Bench dataset for evaluating CheMM-R1 model performance on chemistry tasks.

	
		
		Overview
	

The CheMM-Bench dataset is automatically downloaded when you run test.sh. It contains test data for evaluating multimodal chemistry understanding capabilities.

	
		
		Directory Structure
	

After running test.sh, this directory will contain:
data/
├── README.md              # This file
├── test.jsonl            # Ground truth test… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymous1735/CheMM-Bench.
reputation: Niche dataset primarily used to evaluate CheMM-R1; limited broader adoption so far.
